Misa ukwenza isipele idatha yedivayisi (efana namaphasiwedi we-Wi-Fi nomlando wekholi) nedatha yohlelo lokusebenza (efana nezilungiselelo namafayela agcinwe yizinhlelo zokusebenza, uphinde ususe wonke amakhophi ku-Google Drayivu?

Yenza isipele ngokuzenzakalela idatha yedivayisi (efana namaphasiwedi we-Wi-Fi nomlando wokushaya) nedatha yohlelo lokusebenza (efana nezilungiselelo namafayela agcinwe yizinhlelo zokusebenza) ku-Google Drayivu.

Uma uvula isipele ngokuzenzakalela, idatha yedivayisi neyohlelo lokusebenza ilondolozwa ngezikhathi ezithile kufolda yobumfihlo ku-Google Drayivu. Idatha yohlelo lokusebenza kungaba yinoma iyiphi idatha uhlelo lokusebenza oluyilondolozile (kususelwa kuzilungiselelo zonjiniyela), okufaka idatha enamandla wokuzwela efana noxhumana nabo, imilayezo, nesithombe.

Idatha eyenziwe isipele ngeke ibalwe ngokubhekiswe ku-quota yesitoreji sakho seDrayivu. Amafayela amakhulu, noma onjiniyela bamafayela abakhethe ukuyikhipha kusukela kusevisi ngeke yenziwe isipele.

Ukuskena kusebenza ngokuyimfihlo khona kanye kudivayisi yakho, kubheka umsebenzi we-app ukuthola ubugebengu bokweba imininingwane ebucayi noma okunye ukuziphatha okukhohlisayo. Uma kutholwa, olunye ulwazi lwe-app luthunyelwa ku-Google Play Protect ukuze kuqinisekiswe usongo nokuxwayisa abasebenzisi be-app.

Lesi isakhi esiqondene nezokuvikela esivikelwe. Ayikho idivayisi noma ulwazi lomuntu siqu olwabiwe ne-Google. \n\nUbugebengu bokweba imininingwane ebucayi kuwumzamo wokweba izimfanelo zokungena ngemvume noma olunye ulwazi lomuntu siqu.

Ukuhlola Ubunikazi nePixel Watch

Izibuyekezo:
  • Ngokuxhuma iPixel Watch 3 noma eyakamuva, ungasebenzisa ama-biometric noma Iphinikhodi yakho ukuze ungene kuma-app lapho ungekho endaweni ethenjwayo.
  • Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, Ukuhlola Ubunikazi kungase kwengeze ezinye izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuthi nguwe futhi kuvikele ama-app edivayisini yakho. Funda kabanzi mayelana nokuthi uvikelwa nini futhi kuphi
